sentence: The hospital evidence makes the point from inside the corpus: assessing AI's payoff requires endogeneity controls
passage: [Pham et al. (2024), p. 1] "we find that hospitals with a larger market share are great candidates to adopt AI." / "Importantly, we demonstrate that controlling for endogeneity is essential in assessing the performance outcomes of AI adoption."
